newsitem.title: CHINA: HK police search for illegal Vietnamese refugees.
newsitem.headline: HK police search for illegal Vietnamese refugees.

text.p: Hong Kong police arrested 11 illegal Vietnamese immigrants on Monday and were searching nearby Lantau island for others, a police spokesman said.
The refugees said they were dropped off by a freighter on Sunday and claimed that some 600 illegal immigrants were aboard the ship.
A land and sea search was underway around Lantau island, the spokesman said.
The spokesman said the refugees would be repatriated as soon as possible.
